_note: robofast PWI server (Alpaca Telescope + Focuser + Rotator) for MINERVA T2, through an SSH tunnel: docs/pwi.md, docs/remote.md.

PWI4 4.1.6 is installed and tested on T2 (2026-11-02); its HTTP API listens on the PC's 127.0.0.1:8220 only, reached through the PC's own sshd (docs/remote.md). Only one of PWI2 and PWI4 may own the mount.
PWI is reached on 127.0.0.1:7142 (PWI4); the tunnel's far end is the telescope's control PC, set up by the operator, not here.
allow_hardware is true, but nothing talks to the real PWI without --hardware on the command line as well (robofast/hwgate.py).
Limits (deg): min_alt = legacy telescope_N.ini HORIZON (21), max_alt = legacy scheduler.ini MAXALT (83); park = legacy control.telescope_park defaults (alt 25, az 0).
focus_min/focus_max (microns) = legacy telescope_N.ini MINFOCUS/MAXFOCUS (100/33000); ports = sites/minerva/instruments.json.
max_jog_deg: robofast-pwi-jog's largest relative move per axis (10 deg, the code's ceiling). A stop from full slew speed coasts 6-8 deg (docs/pwi.md, Safety).
Only one of the PWI2 and PWI4 configs of a telescope runs at a time (same listen port); only one of PWI2 and PWI4 may own the mount.

allow_find_home false: the Alpaca server's FindHome stays off; home with robofast-pwi-jog home --axis both (PWI4 4.1.6 cannot home one axis; 4.1.7+ can). Homing under PWI4 4.1.6 was verified on both CDK700s from any start position (docs/pwi.md, Homing).

home_alt/home_az are not set yet: PWI4 4.1.6 reports no homed flag, so robofast counts T2 as homed only after a home it commanded ends at them. Home once with robofast-pwi-jog home --axis both, check on the webcam, and set them from the position it prints (docs/pwi.md, Homing).

az_wrap_min/az_wrap_max: the mechanical azimuth range every goto must end in = PWI2's goto range (-90..450 deg; hard limits -150..510). robofast sets PWI4's axis-0 wrap range per goto so azimuth goes the short legal way: with PWI4's default wrap (0..360) a park at az 0 from home went 264 deg the long way and stalled (docs/pwi.md, Azimuth wrap). Gotos are refused if PWI4 does not report its wrap range.
allow_unhomed_moves true: the engineering override (moves before a recorded home). It does nothing without --allow-unhomed on the command line; set it false once homes are recorded routinely.
